design_summary: The reference: one conditional multi-row UPDATE takes the block or fewer rows come back and it rolls back. Lazy expiry, checked confirmation.

stats.note: size functions are not meaningful on YugabyteDB (storage lives in DocDB, not PostgreSQL heap files)
